scripts.build: pnpm check:patches && pnpm check:tests && pnpm --dir packages/backend runtime:ci build
scripts.check:site: pnpm --filter www exec vitest run --config vitest.afdocs.mts --coverage.enabled=false
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules .cache apps/*/.cache packages/*/.cache .pnpm-store apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo apps/*/.ruff_cache apps/*/.pytest_cache apps/*/.venv apps/*/.coverage .turbo .next apps/*/.next apps/*/.react-email packages/*/.react-email .vercel/output apps/*/.vercel/output coverage apps/*/coverage packages/*/coverage && find apps packages -name __pycache__ -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.lint: pnpm effect:source:check && pnpm check:patches && pnpm check:tests && ultracite check && turbo run lint --filter=cas
scripts.test: pnpm check:patches && pnpm check:tests && pnpm test:scripts && turbo run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm check:patches && pnpm check:tests && turbo run test:coverage
scripts.test:scripts: pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm --filter @repo/testing exec vitest run --root ../.. scripts/check/effect.test.ts scripts/dependencies/policy.test.ts scripts/github/cli.test.ts scripts/github/gate.test.ts scripts/github/policy.test.ts scripts/github/provenance/bundle.test.ts scripts/github/provenance/verify.test.ts scripts/github/release.test.ts scripts/vercel/scope.test.ts scripts/effect/source.test.ts scripts/production/acceptance.test.ts
